text: Do you have an Armor Pass?
Hee hee! Of course! I totally have one![VAR 0114(0042)]
Naturally. I have made all the proper\npreparations, which you can observe with\r\nunclouded eyes.[VAR 0114(0042)]
Please allow me to check your pass.
Hmph. To meet a Slowpoke... Such a thing is\nsimply elegant.[VAR 0114(0042)]
Uh-oh, looks like another one’s gotten on the\ntrain and ridden over from the Isle of Armor.

Is this the first time you’ve seen a
Galarian Slowpoke?\c
The coloring of the top of its head is curry-like.
Isn’t it superduper cute?[VAR 0114(0042)]

Could this be your first time ever seeing a
Galarian Slowpoke?\c
Where they’re from might be different, but
they’re still just as carefree as other Slowpoke.[VAR 0114(0042)]

There’s a lot of Slowpoke living on the
Isle of Armor.\c
Not sure if they feel like traveling or what,
but sometimes a few board the train.
